info.title: Gully AI
info.summary: Ask questions about Gully Labs products and get answers with sources.
info.description:
Gully AI answers questions about Gully Labs and its products from the public docs and from live public figures, and always names its sources. This document covers the public HTTP routes: ask a question, rate the answer, and read what Gully AI knows and whether it is answering now.

## Calling it

No key is needed. Every POST must carry the header `X-Requested-With: gully` and a JSON body. That header cannot be sent from a page on another site, so call the POST routes from your server or from the command line. The two GET routes (status and knowledge) are readable from any origin, including a browser page.

## Limits

| What | Limit |
|---|---|
| Question length | 500 characters |
| Request body | 16 KB |
| History read | last 4 entries, 600 characters each |
| Questions from one place | 6 a minute, 60 a day |
| Written answers, whole service | about 2,000 a day |
| Docs-passages answers from one place (when the service is full or busy) | 20 a minute, 200 a day |
| Ratings from one place | 30 a minute, for answers of the last 24 hours |

These are the defaults; the operators may change them, and `GET /api/ask/knowledge` reports the values in force. One place means one IPv4 address or one IPv6 /64. A day runs on US Pacific time. Over a limit the answer is HTTP 429, with a `Retry-After` header (seconds) on questions. No `X-RateLimit-*` headers are sent. When the whole service has reached its daily limit a question is still answered with HTTP 200, as docs passages with no generated text (`degraded` is set).

## Errors

Every error is JSON: `{ "error": "<plain words>" }`, sometimes with a short `code`. Rely on the HTTP status first; most errors carry no code.

| HTTP | code | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 202 | pending | The transaction is not in a block yet. Ask again shortly. |
| 400 | none | The body is not the expected JSON, a field is missing or malformed, the question is empty or too long, or the question looks like a private key or recovery phrase. |
| 400 | bad_input | The transaction hash is not 0x followed by 64 hex characters. |
| 400 | wrong_chain | Only Gully Chain Testnet is supported for now. |
| 402 | credits | Not enough credits. Nothing is charged today; this answer exists for a later paid tier. |
| 403 | none | The `X-Requested-With: gully` header is missing. |
| 404 | none | The answer can no longer be rated (unknown id or past the rating window), or the route is not switched on yet. |
| 404 | not_found | No transaction with that hash was found on Gully Chain Testnet. |
| 405 | none | Wrong method. Questions, ratings and explanations are POST; status and knowledge are GET. |
| 413 | none | The request body is too large. |
| 429 | none | Too many requests from one place this minute or today. Wait `Retry-After` seconds when the header is present. |
| 429 | none | The service has answered as many requests as it can today. Resets at the start of the next day (US Pacific time). On questions this is not an error: the answer becomes docs passages instead. |
| 500 | none | The rating could not be saved. Try again. |
| 502 | none | The answer could not be written just now. Try again. |
| 503 | none | Gully AI is not available yet (`configured` is false), busy, or its writing service did not answer and no docs passages could be found. Try again shortly. |
| 503 | busy | Too many answers are being written at once. Try again in a minute. |
| 503 | provider-unavailable | The writing service is unavailable. Try again later. |
| 503 | unavailable | The chain could not be read just now. Try again shortly. |

## Good to know

Answers are information only: no advice and no predictions. Questions are logged without a raw IP address (a salted hash only) and kept for a limited time; the knowledge route gives the details and how to ask for deletion.

post.description:
Answers one question about Gully Labs and its products from the public docs, with numbered sources. Some answers also read live public figures (for example a plan price in USD or the status page) and return them as cards.

**Limits.** A question is at most 500 characters and the body at most 16 KB. One visitor may ask 6 questions a minute and 60 a day. The service as a whole writes about 2,000 answers a day.

**History.** Send the earlier turns of the same conversation in `history`. Only the last 4 entries are read and each is cut to 600 characters.

**When the service is full or its writing service is down** the answer is still HTTP 200: `degraded` names the reason, `model` is null and `answer` holds the closest docs passages with links, with no generated text. The `X-Ask-Degraded` header carries the same reason.

**Streaming.** Send `Accept: text/event-stream` to get server-sent events: zero or more `status` events (`{ "stage": ... }`), then one `answer` event with the same JSON as the plain answer, or one `error` event (`{ "error", "status", "code"? }`). A request refused before work starts (bad body, missing header, over the limit) is answered with a plain JSON error and its HTTP status, not a stream. Once the stream is open the HTTP status is 200 even when it ends in an `error` event.

**Privacy.** Emails, phone numbers and keys in a question are masked before it is logged or sent on. Never send a private key or recovery phrase: such a question is refused. `GET /api/ask/knowledge` says where a question goes and what is kept.

A visitor signed in to the Gully Labs app in the same browser can also ask about their own workspace; `signedIn` says whether that applied. No key is needed.

Information only: no advice and no predictions.

schema.description: Server-sent events. Each event is `event: <name>` then `data: <one line of JSON>` then a blank line. Names: `status` (data: StreamStatus), `answer` (data: Answer), `error` (data: StreamError). The stream closes after `answer` or `error`.

post.summary: Rate an answer up or down
post.description: Stores one rating for an answer given in the last 24 hours, by its `id`. A second rating of the same answer replaces the first. The question is taken from the server's own record of that answer, never from this request. A thumbs-down also keeps the answer text and its sources so the docs can be fixed. At most 30 ratings a minute from one place; the body is at most 2 KB.

post.summary: Explain a transaction in plain words (not switched on yet)
post.description:
**Not switched on yet.** Until it is, every call is answered with HTTP 404 `{ "error": "not found" }`. The shape below is what it answers once it is on, and may still change.

Reads one transaction on Gully Chain Testnet (chain 485590) and returns the facts (who sent it, what moved, approvals, the fee in ETH and USD) and a short explanation written only from those facts. When the explanation cannot be written or does not match the facts, a fixed-template explanation is returned instead and `source` is `template`.

**Limits.** 4 calls a minute and 40 a day from one place, inside the same service-wide daily limit as questions. The body is at most 2 KB.

Every answer carries the label "Testnet: no real value". USD figures use current prices, not the price at the time of the transaction. Information only.

question.description: The question, in plain words. Runs of spaces are collapsed before the length is checked.

history.description: Earlier turns of this conversation, oldest first. Only the last 4 entries are read; each is cut to 600 characters.

holders.description: Optional: the Holder Map the question is asked from, so the answer can read that map.

chain.description: Chain name as the Holder Map uses it.

token.description: Token address or ticker: letters and digits only.

id.description: Use it to rate the answer within 24 hours.

answer.description: The answer text. `[1]` marks a source in `citations`; `[L1]` marks a live read in `live`.

usedTools.description: Names of the live reads the answer used.

model.description: Name of the model that wrote the answer. null on a docs-passages answer.

retrieval.description: How the docs were searched: by keywords, or keywords plus meaning.

degraded.description: Present only when the answer is docs passages with no generated text: the service-wide daily limit was reached (cap), too many answers were being written (busy), or the writing service did not answer (provider).

signedIn.description: true when the request came from a visitor signed in to the Gully Labs app.

n.description: The number used in the answer text.

source.description: The kind of page, for example docs or blog.

n.description: The label used in the answer text.

url.description: Where the figures can be checked.

asOf.description: When the figures were read (ISO time or a millisecond timestamp).

Card.description: A small panel built from a live read itself, never from the generated text, so its figures are exactly what was read.

cite.description: The live read it belongs to.

value.description: Already formatted for display. Money is in USD.

chart.description: A small line (`spark`: `points`, oldest first) or bars (`bars`). Absent or null with fewer than two points.

Action.description: A suggested next step as a link. `prefill` opens a form already filled in; nothing is created until the visitor saves it.

stage.description: What is happening now: `thinking`, `tool:<name>`, `writing` (`tool:<name>` names the live read in progress).

status.description: The HTTP status the same failure has without streaming.

configured.description: false while Gully AI is not set up: questions are answered with 503.

model.description: Name of the model that writes answers.

indexSize.description: Docs passages that can be searched.

updatedAt.description: When the passages were last refreshed.

provider.description: Whether the writing service is answering.

since.description: Since when `provider` has had its current value, when known.

cap.description: Today's service-wide limit: null, `warn` at 80 % or `full` when reached (answers become docs passages).

status.description: How much Gully AI has to answer from for this product.

general.description: Passages that name no single product.

owned.description: false: Gully AI is software around third-party model providers, not a model Gully Labs trains or hosts.

providers.description: The services that receive text, and exactly what they receive.

rawIp.description: false: a raw IP address is never stored.

perChatPerMin.description: Per chat on the Telegram bot.

chainId.description: Optional. Only 485590 (Gully Chain Testnet) is supported for now.

explanation.description: A few plain sentences written only from `facts`.

source.description: `template` when the fixed wording was used.

fellBackBecause.description: Present when `source` is `template`: why the written explanation was not used.

usage.description: Present when a model wrote the explanation: its token counts.

TransactionFacts.description: What was read from the chain. Money is in ETH and USD; USD fields are null when no price was available.

actor.description: Who acted: the sender, or the smart account behind a bundled operation.

aa.description: Set when the transaction carries smart-account operations.

sourcePublished.description: Whether the contract source is published.

graph.description: The same facts as nodes, edges and steps for drawing a flow.

code.description: A short code. Most errors carry none.

configured.description: false on the 503 sent while Gully AI is not set up.

x-rate-limit.note: No X-RateLimit-* headers are sent. Retry-After (seconds) comes with a 429 on questions and explanations. Defaults: 6 questions a minute and 60 a day from one place.
